prompts:
The ferry company's boarding screens play a short recorded announcement. The next one is this sentence:

"Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

Deliver it as spoken audio in `./announcement.wav`, a WAV file of 4 to 8 seconds that a passenger can understand.
answers:
[goal]
Deliver the ferry announcement as intelligible spoken audio in `./announcement.wav`, 4–8 seconds long.

[action]
Generated the WAV with Windows SAPI (`System.Speech`, Microsoft Hazel Desktop, en-GB voice, normal rate) speaking the exact sentence. Checked duration with `ffprobe` and verified the spoken content with AGY audio transcription.

[result]
`./announcement.wav` created: 22,050 Hz mono 16-bit PCM, 5.58 s (within 4–8 s). AGY transcription returned "Welcome aboard the evening ferry. Please keep your bags clear of the doors." — an exact word-for-word match to the brief — and rated it clear and easily understandable. Assumptions made where the brief was open: an en-GB voice (ferry/boarding context), female voice, and normal speaking rate for passenger comprehension. No browser tabs, windows, or apps were opened, so nothing needed closing.

[next]
None; the deliverable is complete and verified.
